description: Address two code review issues: (1) Include current access token in frontend refresh request for token rotation blacklist, (2) Downgrade TRUST_EDGE_AUTH validator to warning in non-production environments to avoid breaking local dev.
steps: In apps/frontend/src/hooks/useAuthRefresh.js: Add getToken to the import from ./useTokenManager. In _doRefresh(), before the axios.post call, get the current token via getToken() and include it as access_token in the request body.

In apps/backend/app/config.py: Change the TRUST_EDGE_AUTH + EDGE_SHARED_SECRET check in validate_production_secrets to only raise ValueError in production/staging. In other environments, log a warning instead.
acceptance_criteria: Frontend _doRefresh sends { refresh_token, access_token } in the refresh request body
Backend validate_production_secrets only raises ValueError for missing EDGE_SHARED_SECRET in production/staging, and logs a warning in other environments
Both files have no syntax errors
verification: Babel parse or acorn parse on apps/frontend/src/hooks/useAuthRefresh.js
